name: count_guests_here
purpose: Walks all 16 party records and counts those whose inn-location byte (record offset 0x1f, DGROUP 0x55c7 + 32*i) equals g_location, i.e. companions left at this inn. Active party members have 0 there, so they never match inside a settlement.

0x55c7.name: g_party_inn_location
0x55c7.meaning: settlement number of the inn a member stays at (save 0x1f per record), 0 = with the party

notes: Address shared with FONT/CAST2/COMSUBS e1e0 (vectors 1778:0566/0986/099e are theirs).

name: check_room_available
purpose: Prints two newlines (0x4d84) and returns 1 when count_guests_here() < g_inn_room_counts[slot] (0x4dc4: 3,4,3,2,2,2 rooms). Otherwise prints '"I am sorry, milady/sir, but we have no room available."' (gender 0x0c = milady) and returns 0.

0x4dc4.name: g_inn_room_counts
0x4dc4.meaning: rooms per inn slot (currently named g_unk_4dc4)

notes: The 'gender' is the member's record byte 0x09 widened to int.

name: inn_rest
proto: int inn_rest(int intelligence, int gender, int result)
purpose: Ghidra order (result, gender, intelligence); Rust keeps it. Echoes 'R'. No room -> 0xfffe. Price = g_inn_rates[slot] (0x4d7e: 2,3,2,3,2,3) * g_party_count, adjusted by price*(100-3*INT)/100 with signed multiply and SIGNED divide (__aFldiv, price sign-extended). Prints the room text (SHOPPE.DAT g_inn_room_text_offsets[slot]) and 'Wilt thou take it?' (ask_yes_no) then two newlines. 'N' -> result unchanged. gold < price -> 'Highwaymen! Cheap, at that! OUT!' screams $ -> result unchanged. Else: pay, surcharge, status, 'Have a pleasant night, sir!' says $, animate_wait(10), set_town_map_tile(g_door_y, g_door_x, g_door_tile) (restores the open door), saves g_active_member, party x/y = g_inn_bed_x/y[slot], g_view_dirty = 1, every 'G' member becomes 'S', status + map refresh, 'Zzzzzz....', 12 x pass_time(5), then until g_hour == 6: animate_wait(1), regeneration_ring_tick, draw_status_window, pass_time(9), and TOWN toggle_night_tiles when the hour is 20 or 5. 'Morning!', TOWN init_town_npcs. For each member (index < party count) not 'D': hp = max hp; class 'A'/'M': mp = INT, 'B': mp = INT/2; status 'P' -> 'D', hp 0, newline + name + ' has passed away.'; 'S' -> 'G'. Then party x += 1, view dirty, active member restored, status window, returns 0xffff.
notes: The dead-by-poison message prints the record (name at offset 0). Fighters keep their MP (no branch).

name: inn_leave_companion
proto: int inn_leave_companion(int intelligence, int gender, int result)
purpose: Ghidra order (result, gender, intelligence). Echoes 'L'. No room -> result. Party of one -> SHOPPE.DAT 0x26e8 ('Lord British is missing, and all thou dost plan to do is SLEEP for a month or so? Not in my inn!') and 0xffff. Loop: '$ asks, "Who will stay?"' select_party_member_no_zero: -1 -> 'Nobody', result 0xfffe; 0 (Avatar) -> 'Thy friend' + 's' when party > 2 + ' will not leave thee!' and ask again; dead member -> SHOPPE.DAT 0x2723 ('a morgue?'), result 0xffff; else price = g_inn_rates[slot]*10 adjusted (signed divide, price high word 0), 'The rate for our most comfortable room will be % gold per month, due at check-out. Wilt thou take it?' (ask_yes_no); 'Y': result 1, g_active_member cleared to 0xff if it is the leaver or decremented if greater (and not 0xff), the leaver's record gets inn location = g_location and months-at-inn = 0, is copied to a local, records m+1..15 are shifted down one slot (15-m copies of 32 bytes), the copy is stored as record 15 (0x5788), g_party_count -= 1, status window, '"I thank thee." says $.'
notes: Ghidra mislabels the SHOPPE.DAT offsets 0x26e8/0x2723 as DGROUP strings; they are print_shoppe_dat file offsets.

name: prev_guest
purpose: Scans the party records below idx (idx-1 down to 1) for one whose inn-location byte equals g_location and returns its index, or 0 when none is found (record 0 is the Avatar and never a guest). Used by the guest-register browser for the up keys.

name: next_guest
purpose: Scans the party records above idx (idx+1 up to 15) for one whose inn-location byte equals g_location and returns its index; returns 0 when the scan runs past record 15. next_guest(0) yields the first guest.

name: inn_pick_up_companion
purpose: Ghidra order (result, intelligence). Party of 6 -> 'One must first be left behind!' (returns result); no guest here -> '"No one here is from thy party!" says $.' (result). One guest: selected via next_guest(0). Several: '"Who will check out?"', text window 1 with the status separator cleared, define_text_window(9,0x26,1,0x18,1) + 0xff then (9,0x27,...) and a frame drawn with glyphs 0x10/0x11x13/0x13, 0x17 at columns 0 and 14 of rows 1..7, 0x14/0x15x13/0x16, titles 'GUEST' / 'REGISTER:' and every guest name (records 1..15 with inn location == g_location) at column 4. Window 2 is reselected and a highlight browser runs: XOR bar (set_color(g_ui_color1), fill_rect_xor(y+7, 0x131, y, 0xc6), y from 0x28 in steps of 8); keys 1/3 = prev_guest, 2/4 = next_guest (bar moves only when a guest exists), Enter/space accept, Esc -> 'No one' and nobody; other keys ignored. Then draw_status_separator and draw_status_window. Nobody -> result. Price = max(1, months at inn) * (g_inn_rates[slot]*10 intelligence-adjusted with the signed divide); '"That will be % gold, please."'. gold < price -> SHOPPE.DAT 0x275a ('thou dost not possess the necessary funds! GUARDS!') + TOWN raise_alarm, return 0xffff. Else pay, surcharge, status; the guest record is copied out, records party_count..sel-1 shift up one slot (sel - party_count copies from sel downward), the copy lands in slot party_count, party_count += 1, inn location byte cleared. 'P' status -> 'D', HP 0, 'Thy friend has died, by the way.'; else HP = max HP, MP = INT (A/M) or INT/2 (B), 'I hope thou hast found thy stay enjoyable,'. Then 'says $.', status window, return 1.
notes: The record shift uses 0x5588 (= 0x55a8 - 0x20) as the base of 'record sel-1'; Ghidra shows it as s_POISON_ + sel*0x20. get_cursor_row is called with a leftover argument (4) in the C; it takes none.

name: inn_shop
purpose: Inn entry (vector 1778:0a22, TALK shop type 7). Captures the member's INT (0x55b6) and gender byte (0x55b1), clears g_protection_turns and g_status_icon, draws the status window and the greeting. Outer loop: Y/N read (space = 'N'; prints 'No'/'Yes'); 'N' ends. Then '$ asks, "Art thou here to Pick up or Leave a companion, or to Rest for the night?"' and a key: space -> done; 'L' -> inn_leave_companion(result, gender, INT): a return above -2 replaces result, result -1 ends; 'P' -> inn_pick_up_companion(result, INT): replaces result, -1 ends; 'R' -> inn_rest(result, gender, INT): any return above -2 (i.e. not 'no room') ends with that result; other keys re-read. If not done, '"Is there anything more I can do for thee?"' then back to the Y/N read. Finally print_farewell(result): 0 'nothing bought', 1 'thanks', -1 silent.
notes: result is a 16-bit int carried through the three handlers as their first (Ghidra) parameter; -2 = 'no room' leaves it untouched.
